Nadia, Gideon landed on **280 seats** for Vantorre Group in his Jul 1 update in #strategic-pod.

He first posted 300. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of Jul 1. Ruth also asked him to put the corrected figure in the Q3 QBR deck.

For the roster sheet, use 280, not the 300 in his first line. That's the July figure only. I didn't look for anything more recent.
